name: Xxentria Technology Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Xxentria Technology Materials Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells steel composite materials in the United States, Asia, and internationally. It offers architectural products, including laminated, lacquer, PVD coating, and anodizing for exterior facades cladding and interior furnishing for new buildings, as well as refurbishment applications; solar receiver tube and reflective materials for concentrated solar power, residential and industrial solar thermal, cooling, heating, and desalination. The company also provides galvanized steel composite panels and tensile aluminum composite panels for composite wall panels and door panels for truck and trailer bodies.
